summary: Makes TypeSubstitutionUtils restore annotations onto the implicit upper bound of unbounded wildcards, using detached copies of javac TypeVar/CapturedType objects and cycle detection for F-bounded type variables.

tests.evidence: Behavior change needs tests; lazaroclapp noted the test checker silently returns NO_MATCH for unexpected field names (test can become a no-op), fixed to throw in the final diff; he also noted the F-bound cycle detection is untested here (deferred to #1668).

user_docs.evidence: Internal generics machinery; no option, flag, or documented behavior changes.

doc_comments.evidence: Adds a public method and new interface methods on TypeMetadataBuilder with subtle javac-identity invariants (baseType override, delegating wrappers); their Javadoc must match the code. It does in the initial version.

change_description.evidence: Description explains the why (preparatory for #1668, the two subtleties); NullAway writes CHANGELOG at release time.

performance.evidence: Adds an IdentityHashMap bookkeeping per wildcard visit and extra type copies on the restore path; unlikely to matter.

security.evidence: No auth, crypto, or untrusted input.

backward_compat.evidence: Uses javac internal constructors that differ across supported JDKs; CodeRabbit raised JDK 21 constructor compatibility, which the chosen stable constructors already address; CI covers the JDK matrix.

concurrency.evidence: Core concern is not mutating shared compiler-owned type objects (visible to other checkers); the detached copies handle it, a glance suffices; no threads.

error_model.evidence: Adds Verify checks; CodeRabbit flagged the silent fallback `t.wildcard.bound != null ? t.wildcard.bound : t` in visitCapturedType, left unchanged in final.

correctness.evidence: Non-trivial type-substitution logic: cycle detection across F-bounded type variables, type identity via baseType(), metadata ordering in copyMetadata; mandated by complexity, no defect confirmed.

user_value.evidence: Preparatory internal refactor with no user-facing API.

surprising_behavior.evidence: Changes which annotations are restored onto unbounded wildcards, which can change diagnostics in JSpecify mode; user-visible effect lands with #1668.

contradictions.evidence: Test class Javadoc says the special field names select operations; the NO_MATCH default for other names lets a typo pass silently, which the final version replaces with a throw.

observability.evidence: Compiler plugin internals; no logging involved.

spec_conformance.evidence: Implements the JSpecify rule that an unbounded wildcard takes the upper bound of the corresponding formal type variable (Javadoc of replaceUnboundedWildcardUpperBound).

plan.why: Three files in one cohesive generics change; one reviewer can hold the javac type model for all required axes.
